title: Wick Liq Bar Juice Pink Lemonade 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Wick Liq Bar Juice Pink Lemonade is a vibrant summer cooler. It features a sharp, zesty lemonade base infused with the sweet, juicy taste of summer berries. Bursting with citrus and fruit notes, it offers a tangy and refreshing vape that sparkles on the palate. The Wick Liq Bar Juice collection sees the Staffordshire flavour experts apply a "double concentrate" formulation to their premium blends. By doubling the flavour dosage, these "Bar Salts" deliver an exceptionally intense and consistent taste experience that remains rich and full-bodied, even when used in low-power starter kits and MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod devices. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is optimised for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It is designed to pair flawlessly with refillable pod kits, producing discreet vapour and crystal-clear flavour. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. Wick Liq Bar Juice Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
